🏀 Welcome to Basketball Training!
Are you ready to become a basketball icon? 🔥

Train, shoot, and dunk your way to greatness in this fast-paced hoop adventure. Build insane strength, unlock legendary basketballs, and break distance records with half-court and full-court shots to reach new arenas!

Don’t just shoot — DOMINATE THE COURT LIKE A TRUE MVP!

🎁 Exclusive Rewards
Use Code: release

🎮 How to Play

💪 Train to gain Strength.
🐶 Collect: Hatch powerful pets to boost your stats!
🏀 Shoot: Launch insane shots to earn massive Cash!
🔥 Upgrade: Unlock legendary basketballs with crazy effects!
Tags: Basketball, Sports, Shooter, Dunk, Simulator, Pets, Hoops, Fun, Cool
